book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Yɨɨsu ariija igʉrʉ wu ukukwɨra nʉ ʉkʉtaana
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kʉgamba amangʼana gayo, akabhʉʉka Gariraaya, akahɨta rusizʉ, mucharʉ kɨnʉ kiri imwambʉkʉ wɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ cha Yorodaani kuja mucharʉ cha Yudeya.
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakabha bharamutuna iyo, nawe akahorya abharwɨrɨ bhanʉ bhaarɨ gatɨ waabhʉ.
Neho Abhafarisaayo obhorebhe bhakaaza kwa Yɨɨsu korereke bhamogeme. Bhakabhuurya, “Awɨɨ, nɨ‑bhwaheene umusubhɨ kʉtaana na mʉkaazɨ igʉrʉ wa ryʉryʉsi rirya?”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Imwɨ mʉkɨɨrɨ kosoma mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu kʉbha kwɨma ubhubhumbi ‘Mungu akabhʉmba umusubhɨ nʉ ʉmʉkari’?
Akabhuga, ‘Igʉrʉ wa gayo, umusubhɨ aratiga wiisɨ na unina, aragwatana na mʉkaazɨ. Bhabhɨrɨ bhayo bharabha mʉbhɨrɨ gʉmwɨ.’
Na bhatakʉbha bhabhɨrɨ kwikɨ, nawe nɨ‑mʉbhɨrɨ gʉmwɨ. Mmbe, kɨnʉ kɨgwataniibhwɨ na Mungu, mʉʉtʉ atakɨtaanʼya.”
Nawe, Abhafarisaayo bhakamubhuurya, “Arɨɨbhɨ ganʉ nɨ‑maheene, nɨkɨ Musa akaraganʼya umusubhɨ amohe ʉmʉkari waazɨ ɨnyarʉbha yʉ ʉkʉtaana na komoheebha?”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Musa akabhiisirirya moheebhe abhakari bhaanyu, kʉ kʉbha yʉ ʉbhʉkʉngʼu bhwi imyʉyʉ janyu, nawe kwɨma ʉbhʉtangɨ bhwu ubhubhumbi, bhʉtaarɨ ubhwɨndi bhwa Mungu.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ araatigɨ mʉkaazɨ, ɨtarɨ igʉrʉ wu ubhusiihya, na kukwɨra ʉmʉkari ʉwʉndɨ, wuyo arasebheeta. Nu umusubhɨ wʉnʉ akukwera ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ atigirwɨ, wʉʉsi arasebheeta.”
Neho abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ nɨmbu kumusubhɨ nʉ ʉmʉkari, nɨ‑hakɨrɨku ʉmʉʉtʉ atakwɨra!”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Ɨtarɨ bhʉʉsi bharatʉra kʉrɨsʉngʼaana ringʼana rɨnʉ, nawe bhanʉ Mungu abhanagiryɨ kʉtama kukwɨra.

Nɨrabhugabhu, kʉ kʉbha bhareho abhandɨ bhanʉ bhatakukwɨra kʉ kʉbha bhakiibhurwa bhazigaru. Abhandɨ bhatakukwɨra kʉ kʉbha abhaatʉ bhabhasʉrʉʉrirɨ korereke bhatabha bhariibhʉra. Na bhareho na abhandɨ bhanʉ bhatakukwɨra kʉ kʉbha yʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kʉsʉngʼaana ringʼana riyo, arɨsʉngʼaanɨ.”
Yɨɨsu arahaka abhaana abhasuuhu
Mmbe, abhiibhuri obhorebhe bhakareeta abhaana abhasuuhu kwa Yɨɨsu korereke abhahakɨ kʉbhatʉʉrɨra amabhoko na kʉbhasabhɨra. Nawe abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakabhahaarɨra.
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Mutigɨ abhaana abhasuuhu bhaazɨ kwa niinyɨ! Mʉtabharecha, kʉ kʉbha ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ nɨ‑bhwa abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaangɨ ncha abhaana.”
Yɨɨsu akahaka abhaana bhayo, akʉmara akabhʉʉka ahagero hayo.
Ʉbhʉkʉngʼu kumuniibhi kusikɨra mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu
Akʉmara ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ akaaza kwa Yɨɨsu, akamubhuurya, “Umwija, nekore ingʼanakɨ rizʉmu korereke nebhone ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano?”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Kwakɨ ʉrambuurya inyɨ igʉrʉ wa ringʼana rizʉmu? Rora, Mungu umwene newe ʉmʉzʉmu! Nawe arɨɨbhɨ oreenda kusikɨra kʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano, ugwatɨ imigirʉ ja Mungu.”
Umumura wuyo akamubhuurya, “Migirʉkɨ?” Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Utiita, ʉtasebheeta, utiibha, ʉtagobha mʉʉtʉ,
ʉsʉʉkɨ wuusʉ na onyoko, ʉmʉsɨɨgɨ nyarʉbhɨri waazʉ chɨmbu wisɨɨgirɨ aumwene.”
Umumura wuyo akabhuga, “Imigirʉ jʉsi giyo nigigwatirɨ. Nekorekɨ ɨkɨndɨ kɨnʉ kisuuhirɨ?”

Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ oreenda kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ataana isoro, nuujɨ uguryɨ ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ ʉnabhyʉ, zimpirya ziyo ʉbhahɨ abhahabhɨ, na ʉrabha ni ikibhumbɨkʉ kwa Mungu. Akʉmara uuzɨ untunɨ.”
Hanʉ umumura wuyo iigwirɨ gayo, akaja arumikirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ ne ebhegero bhyaru.
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ akabhuga, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ɨrabha kʉkʉngʼu kumuniibhi kusikɨra mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra naatu, nɨ‑kʉnyʉʉhu ɨngamiya kʉhɨta mwibhanga ryi isindanʉ, kʉkɨra umuniibhi kusikɨra mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu.”
Hanʉ abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhiigwirɨ ɨbhu, bhakarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu, bhakamubhuurya, “Nangʉ, nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kʉsabhurwa?”
Yɨɨsu akabhamogorera, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Kʉbhaatʉ gatakʉtʉrɨkana, nawe kwa Mungu gʉʉsi garatʉrɨkana.”
Peetero akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Rora, itwɨ tutigirɨ ebhegero bhyʉsi, tukutunirɨ! Mmbe, na niitwɨ tʉrabhonakɨ?”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ arabha ikɨɨrɨ nchʉ ʉmʉtɨmi kukitumbɨ chazɨ, mʉʉsɨ iihya.
Mmbe, ribhaga riyo na niimwɨ bhanʉ muntunirɨ, muriikara kubhitumbɨ bhyɨ ɨkɨtɨmi ikumi na bhɨbhɨrɨ, ɨnʉ mʉratɨnɨra ɨbhɨgambʉ ikumi na bhɨbhɨrɨ bhya Iziraɨri.

Mmbe, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ atigirɨ inyumba, umwabhʉ, umusubhaati, wiisɨ, unina, abhaana hamwɨ ɨmɨgʉndʉ igʉrʉ waanɨ, arasʉngʼaana bhyʉsi kubhwaru bhʉkʉngʼu. Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, arabhona ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano.
Nawe, abhaatʉ bhaaru bhanʉ bhakusuukwa ribhaga rɨnʉ, bhatakusuukwa ribhaga rɨnʉ rikuuza. Na bhanʉ bhatakusuukwa ribhaga rɨnʉ, bharasuukwa ribhaga rɨnʉ rikuuza.”

footnotes.text: Rora Kʉhʉrʉka 20:12‑16; Abharaawi 19:18; Amahiityʉ gi Imigirʉ 5:16‑20.
